Teenagers do not stay up late because they are lazy. Their circadian clocks shift by about two hours during puberty, which is why a sixteen-year-old is wide awake at eleven and barely conscious at seven. Schools that start at 7:30 in the morning are asking students to perform at the the equivalent of 5:30 for an adult.

When Seattle moved its high school start time to 8:45 in 2016, researchers at the University of Washington found students gained a median of 34 minutes of sleep a night and their grades rose. Districts that refuse to follow stand to loose more than they save on bus schedules.

The science has been settled for twenty years. The obstacle is a bus timetable, and bus timetables can be changed.
